summary: ctparks + ReserveAmerica + map read: $20/$30, W&E $35/$45 confirmed; hookups added (50A + water, sampled 8 electric sites); 558 sites, 35 ft on every site; showers, water, six dumps, store; 2026 season May 22-Oct 12 written; --AWH note kept verbatim with a --Claude line. Stored coastal woods fails on imagery (day-use parking/pavilion complex between) - ask AWH.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored coastal woods, rests on --AWH text, so ASK): imagery (Esri) shows the campground is open grass loops with scattered trees, set back roughly 400-800 m from the Long Island Sound beach, and the land between is the park's developed day-use complex - the large beach parking lots, Meigs Point/West Beach pavilion and park roads - plus salt marsh. The curation doc names 'a developed day-use beach + parking complex' as disqualifying for coastal woods, and the setting is grassy rather than shore forest. The closest RV sites are the Beach Road sites (ReserveAmerica 'Beach Rd Sites 1-28' and '29-36, A - J', standard electric and pop-up/tent; sampled BCH001 and BCHA 50A, 35 ft), about 180-250 m from the beach across open salt marsh and a park road near 41.2668,-72.5630. Recommended: bayview if AWH accepts the marsh-and-Sound view from the Beach Road sites, otherwise not waterfront.

HOOKUPS: stored had none; DEEP says 88 W&E sites, ReserveAmerica lists 139 STANDARD/ADA ELECTRIC sites (some without a water attribute, e.g. BCH001, BCHA, S02). All eight sampled electric sites are 50 amp.
SITE LENGTHS: ReserveAmerica Max Vehicle Length 35 ft on every RV-bookable site (482 standard + 6 ADA) - uniform, possibly a placeholder; POPUP/TENT sites 25 ft. All back-in.
